content.title: Where to watch UFC Fight Night, Adesanya vs. Pyfer tonight, full card, time, free streams
content.text: Updated: Mar. 28, 2026, 3:00 p.m.Published: Mar. 28, 2026, 3:00 p.m.Israel Adesanya prepares to fight Jared Cannonier in a middleweight title bout during the UFC 276 mixed martial arts event Saturday, July 2, 2022, in Las Vegas.AP PhotoIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comFormer UFC middleweight champ Israel Adesanya returns to the octagon Saturday night looking to snap a three-fight losing streak against American Joe Pyfer on UFC Fight Night. The card is scheduled to start with prelims at 5 p.m. ET (2 p.m. PT) with exclusive streaming on Paramount+.How to watch UFC events on Paramount+: Live streams of UFC Fight Night are available on Paramount+ (free trial).A Paramount+ With Showtime plan includes access to UFC fights. The plan comes with a free trial and costs $13.99 per month after that, or $139.99 per year.UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. PyferFull fight card at a glanceWhen: Saturday, March 28 beginning at 5 p.m. ETWhere: Climate Pledge Arena, Seattle, Wash.TV channel: N/ALive streams: Paramount+ (free trial)Adesanya now sits at 24-5-0 in his mixed martial arts career with 16 of those victories coming by knockout. The 36-year-old from Nigeria has lost four of his past five fights, most recently by knockout to Nassourdine Imavov more than a year ago on a Feb. 1 edition of UFC Fight Night. Adesanya is currently listed as the UFC’s No. 4 contender at middleweight, while Pyfer sits at No. 14 in those rankings with his 15-3 overall record and run of three straight victories.
